headline: Bulawayo Oil Processing Plant Nears Completion in Zimbabwe
summary: A new oil processing plant in Bulawayo is nearing completion, aiming to create up to 400 direct jobs and generate business opportunities for local farmers, transport operators, and small-scale entrepreneurs.
why: Infrastructure and agricultural processing investments drive local employment and downstream economic activity in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Zimbabwe
impacts.why: New industrial facilities boost local manufacturing output and employment.
